name: Townsen Crossing
summary: Townsen Crossing is a community shopping center in Humble, Texas, anchored by Academy Sports + Outdoors and Burlington. Located at FM 1960 and Townsen Boulevard, the center features numerous restaurants and retailers serving the northern Houston suburbs.
demographics: Townsen Crossing serves the growing Humble, Texas community along FM 1960, attracting middle-income families and working professionals from the northern Houston metropolitan area. The trade area draws from suburban households with moderate to above-average incomes, typically ranging from $50,000 to $85,000 annually, with a mix of young families, established homeowners, and value-conscious shoppers. Primary visitors are aged 25-54, seeking convenient access to everyday necessities, sporting goods, and family dining options in a accessible open-air shopping environment.
description: Townsen Crossing is a prominent community shopping center strategically located at the intersection of FM 1960 and Townsen Boulevard in Humble, Texas. Anchored by two major retailers—Academy Sports + Outdoors and Burlington—this open-air center serves as a key retail destination for the northern Houston suburbs. The property offers a diverse tenant mix that includes numerous restaurants alongside national retailers, providing convenient one-stop shopping for families and residents throughout the Humble area. Managed by Federal Realty Investment Trust (FRPLT), Townsen Crossing benefits from professional property management and strategic positioning along one of the area's busiest commercial corridors. The center's accessible layout and strong anchor tenants make it a reliable shopping destination for everyday needs, sporting goods, apparel, and dining experiences.
